subject.title: Fix dashboard chat run recovery across reconnects

question: Should maintainers repair this stale branch, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or preserve the useful Dashboard recovery behavior in a replacement PR against current main?
rationale: The PR targets a real open P1 workflow, but its branch conflicts with newer Gateway/UI/protocol ownership and the remaining blockers include merge-risk choices that automation should not silently choose.

options.title: Rebase and reshape before review
options.body: Update the branch to current main's packages/gateway-protocol, Gateway restart lifecycle, and Control UI chat lifecycle owners, then require real Dashboard proof before merge.

options.title: Use as source for replacement
options.body: Carry the useful behavior and attribution into a narrower maintainer-owned replacement PR if rebasing would preserve too much obsolete runtime shape.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Keep the PR open but unmergeable until maintainers decide whether the remaining behavior belongs here or in a newer canonical fix path.

recommendation.title: Rebase and reshape before review
recommendation.body: Update the branch to current main's packages/gateway-protocol, Gateway restart lifecycle, and Control UI chat lifecycle owners, then require real Dashboard proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merger/protocol history makes this the best available owner for deciding whether the stale branch should be reshaped or replaced.
